verses.1: And the second tribe went to Shemion. They were the descendants of Shemion, and their territory became part of the territory of the descendants of Judah.
verses.2: And they had children in Er Sheva and Shavua.
verses.3: And the gardens of Shu’al, and Balah, and A’tsem.
verses.4: And Eltholad, and Bethul, and Kharmah.
verses.5: And Tiklag, and the chariot houses, and Susah’s courtyard.
verses.6: And in the houses of their dwellings and in the halls of those thirty cities, there were also gardens and courtyards.
verses.7: Look at Rimon, Vater, and the smoke from four cities and their courtyards.
verses.8: And all the fields that surround these cities, up to the top of the hill called Rimat Negev, belong to Mattah, sons of Shimeon, for their families.
verses.9: The land of the sons of Judah became part of the territory of the sons of Shem. After all, the sons of Shem were a significant portion of the people of Judah. Therefore, the sons of Shem were also given a share in their own territory.
verses.10: And the third tribe went up to the descendants of Zebulun, to their families. Their territory became a border area until Sharid.
verses.11: And their borders were damaged, and they suffered harm. They also damaged the trees, and they damaged the stream that flowed in front of their homes.
verses.12: And from the ruins ahead, at the eastern edge of the sun’s rays, on the border of the Tabor Mountains, he went out towards the valley. Then he climbed up.
verses.13: And from there, ahead from the east, there was a camp. Now, it’s a military base. And Rimon, who was described as someone who could be trusted, came out of there.
verses.14: And it will be extended from the border of Chanaton. Its exits will be like those of Gei Yiftah-El.
verses.15: And Kattat, Nahalal, Shimron, Yidala, and Beit Laham. There are twenty-two cities in total, along with their courtyards.
verses.16: This is the inheritance of the descendants of Zebulun, for their families, these cities, and their palaces.
verses.17: To Isachar, the fourth son, went the inheritance that belonged to his descendants.
verses.18: And their boundaries were Izreel and its surrounding areas.
verses.19: And their excavations, and Shiyon, and Anaharat.
verses.20: And the rabbit, and Kishion, and Avetz.
verses.21: And Remet, and Ein-Ganim, and Ein-Hada, and the house of Patsets.
verses.22: And the border damaged Tobor and Shachtimah, as well as the house of Shemesh. Their borders extended to twenty-seven cities and their courtyards.
verses.23: This is the inheritance of the sons of Issachar, for their families, the cities, and their palaces.
verses.24: And the fifth soldier went out to meet the sons of Asher, for their families.
verses.25: And their territory consisted of Chelvah, Halivah, Vabeten, and Akshaf.
verses.26: And Alamelech, and Amad, and Mishal, and they attacked Carmel in the morning, as well as Shichor Livenat.
verses.27: And from the east side of the sun, he entered the house of Daggan. He struck Zevulun and Gie Yiftach-El Tsafon. He also entered the house of Ha’emek and Neiyael. Then he went out towards Kavul Mishmal.
verses.28: And Ebron, Rekhov, Chamon, and Kanaan, all up to their borders.
verses.29: And he returned to the high border, all the way to the city of Mizhar-Tzor. And he returned to the border of Chosha. His exits were marked by the line of Akziva.
verses.30: And Umma, Afek, and Rachov had forty cities, along with their courtyards.
verses.31: This is the inheritance of the sons of Asher, for their families and their cities and their palaces.
verses.32: From the trees of Naphtali, the wild rose sprouted. It grew among the branches of Naphtali, for their families.
verses.33: And their boundaries were replaced by those of the people who lived in tents. And the land became barren and uninhabitable. Their exits were through the valley.
verses.34: And the border was covered with dust for a day. Then, from there, a storm arose, and it damaged the ships that were in the sea. It also damaged Judah, which is located to the east of the sun.
verses.35: And the cities of the foreign nations were Zer, Chammat Rakhat, and Kinnaret.
verses.36: And the land, and the mountains, and the walls.
verses.37: And Kedesh, Edrei, and Ein Chazor.
verses.38: And there were also Yeran and Megdal Ehel Cheram, as well as Beit Anat and Beit Shams. There were fifteen cities in total, along with their respective courtyards.
verses.39: This is the inheritance of Matti’s sons, for their families, the cities, and their palaces.
verses.40: To the sons of Dan, to their families, went the seventh warrior.
verses.41: And their territory became Zerah, Eshtol, and the city of Shamas.
verses.43: And even if you were to be destroyed and scattered.
verses.44: And they shall call out to him and lift him up.
verses.45: Vihud, and the sons of Barak, and Gath-Rimon.
verses.46: And from the hills and mountains, along the border opposite Yafo.
verses.47: And the people of Dan went out from them. The people of Dan fought against Lesham, captured her, and took her as their wife. They settled there and called Lesham “Dan”, just like their ancestor Dan did.
verses.48: This is the inheritance of the descendants of Dan for their families and their cities and their palaces.
verses.49: And they divided up the land among its regions. The sons of Israel gave a portion of the land to Jehoiachin, their son.
verses.50: According to Jehovah’s command, the city was given to him. He asked for it from Timnat Serah in Mount Efrayim. And he built the city and settled there.
verses.51: These are the boundaries that were set by Elazar the priest, and Yehoshua ben Nun, along with the leaders of the fathers, for the children of Israel. They marked these boundaries in battle, in peace, and in all places before Jehovah. This was to mark the boundaries of the sanctuary.
